hard_failures.message: Vercel cleanUrls=true and trailingSlash=false canonicalizes the version directory without a trailing slash. Relative scripts/styles resolve outside the version and GameKit never boots. Fix version-independent HTML base resolution before loading styles/scripts, and keep root Docker QA working. Manifest fetch must share the correct base. Do not change the deployment config, GameKit, tests or core gameplay.
